```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R/publication_artifacts.R"))
begin_artifact_render("table_s7")
source(here::here("R/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02", "03", "04", "05", "06"),
  funs = c("model_fun", "calculate_outcomes", "cea_helpers", "report_format",
           "psa_functions", "evppi_functions", "scenario_analysis"),
  packages = c("here", "dplyr", "tidyr", "knitr", "kableExtra", "scales"),
  set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
cache_file <- scenario_evppi_path()
if (!file.exists(cache_file)) {
  stop(
    "Full scenario cache not found: ", cache_file, ". Run ",
    "analysis/12_scenario_EVPPIs.R before rendering Table S7."
  )
}
evppi_cache <- load_scenario_cache(path = cache_file)

# Table S7 reports the joint ([GROUP]) EVPPI rows only, one row per group and
# scenario, plus total EVPI as the reference. Per-parameter rows are never added
# to group rows: EVPPI is not additive, and summing them produced group values
# above total EVPI in earlier versions (issue #152).
# Drug and test unit prices are fixed in the PSA since issue #154, so those
# groups are absent from current caches; they stay in the ordering so older
# caches still sort correctly.
group_order <- c(
  "other_costs", "drug_costs", "test_costs", "all_costs",
  "utilities", "prevalence",
  paste0("interaction_", get_biomarkers()), "interaction_all"
)

to_population <- function(x) {
  calculate_population_evppi(
    x,
    annual_incidence = annual_incidence_norway,
    research_horizon = research_horizon_years,
    discount_rate = discount_rate_research
  )
}

evppi_all <- compile_evppi_results(evppi_cache$all_scenario_results)
evppi_table <- data.frame(Status = "No scenario results")
if (nrow(evppi_all) > 0) {
  if (!"evppi_se" %in% names(evppi_all)) evppi_all$evppi_se <- NA_real_
  if (!"n_params" %in% names(evppi_all)) evppi_all$n_params <- NA_integer_

  scenario_order <- evppi_cache$scenarios$scenario_id

  group_rows <- evppi_all %>%
    filter(grepl("^\\[GROUP\\] ", parameter)) %>%
    transmute(
      scenario_id, scenario_name, wtp,
      group = sub("^\\[GROUP\\] ", "", parameter),
      param_group = evppi_group_label(parameter),
      n_params,
      evppi, evppi_se, evppi_percent_of_evpi, evpi, error, method,
      evppi_population_millions = to_population(evppi),
      evppi_se_population_millions = to_population(evppi_se)
    )

  evpi_rows <- evppi_all %>%
    filter(parameter == "[EVPI]") %>%
    transmute(
      scenario_id, scenario_name, wtp,
      group = "evpi",
      param_group = "All parameters (EVPI)",
      n_params = NA_integer_,
      evppi = evpi, evppi_se = NA_real_, evppi_percent_of_evpi, evpi, error, method,
      evppi_population_millions = to_population(evpi),
      evppi_se_population_millions = NA_real_
    )

  evppi_table <- bind_rows(evpi_rows, group_rows) %>%
    mutate(
      scenario_rank = match(scenario_id, scenario_order),
      group_rank = match(group, c("evpi", group_order))
    ) %>%
    arrange(scenario_rank, group_rank) %>%
    select(-scenario_rank, -group_rank)


}
```

```{r display-table}
if (nrow(evppi_all) > 0) {
  display_df <- evppi_table %>%
    mutate(
      WTP = scales::dollar(wtp, prefix = "EUR ", accuracy = 1),
      Parameters = ifelse(is.finite(n_params), as.character(n_params), "--"),
      EVPPI = format_eur(evppi, accuracy = 0.01),
      SE = format_eur(evppi_se, accuracy = 0.01),
      `Percent of EVPI` = ifelse(is.finite(evppi_percent_of_evpi),
                                 sprintf("%.1f%%", evppi_percent_of_evpi), "--"),
      `Population EVPPI` = paste0("EUR ", sprintf("%.2f", evppi_population_millions), "M")
    ) %>%
    select(Scenario = scenario_name, WTP, `Parameter Group` = param_group,
           Parameters, EVPPI, SE, `Percent of EVPI`, `Population EVPPI`, Error = error)

  kable(
    display_df,
    caption = "Table S7: Joint EVPPI by parameter group and scenario",
    format = "html",
    align = c("l", "r", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "l")
  ) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                  full_width = FALSE, font_size = 11) %>%
    footnote(
      general = paste0(
        "EVPPI estimated by nonparametric regression (voi::evppi, GAM; Strong et al. 2014) ",
        "with Monte Carlo standard errors (SE) from 1,000 regression-coefficient draws. ",
        "Each group row is one joint estimate for all parameters in the group; group ",
        "rows are not sums of single-parameter EVPPIs. 'All parameters (EVPI)' is the ",
        "total expected value of perfect information for the scenario. Exact zero EVPI bounds every group at zero; missing or failed estimates are NA with an error. Percentages at zero EVPI are undefined. Population ",
        "scaling: ", annual_incidence_norway, " patients/year over ",
        research_horizon_years, " years, discounted at ",
        scales::percent(discount_rate_research, accuracy = 0.1), "."
      ),
      general_title = "Notes: "
    )
} else {
  knitr::kable(evppi_table)
}
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
{
  tables_dir <- here("outputs", "tables")
  if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  write_artifact_csv(evppi_table, file = here("outputs", "tables", "table_s7.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
```
